content.text:
This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations.
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows line drawings of various aircraft cargo and tie-down fittings, organized into groups with titles and descriptive notes.

PAN FITTINGS
Stud & Cargo ring
Cargo ring only
Stud only

SINGLE STUD FITTINGS
Round head
Hex head

SINGLE STUD CARGO TIE DOWN FITTING
Lift to release

These types of fittings are suitable for cargo tie down attachment to the single stud fittings or stud equipped pan fittings shown above.

SINGLE STUD HOLD DOWN FITTINGS

These types of fittings are suitable for litter or berth attachment to the single stud fittings or stud equipped pan fittings shown above.

STUD/RING

EYE BOLT

These types of fittings are suitable for litter, berth, and/or cargo tie down attachment directly to the aircraft structure.
